18.evidenceText: Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kit for Clik Valve. Utilizes Clik Valves for best-in-class performance. Available in 44mm and 60mm.

27.evidenceText: Four distinct product URLs identified: p1859948 (main valve set), p1859954 (DV-SCV kit), p1859951 (SV-SCV kit), p1859953 (SV-SCV with pump adapter). Source 2 is a category filter page, not a distinct product listing.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs (p-numbered pages) that represent distinct Clik valve products. Excluded the category/filter page (source 2) as it is not a product listing. Each p-numbered URL represents a distinct product SKU.

30.extractionRationale: Stock status cannot be determined - all three product listing sources contain no content text that would indicate availability status (out of stock, unavailable, nicht verfügbar, ausverkauft, etc.)

37.evidenceText: The source mentions valve inserts (Sclaverand, Presta, Dunlop, tubeless valve) and an adapter but does not provide a specific count of distinct replacement/spare part SKUs.
37.extractionRationale: The source does not contain explicit information about the total number of distinct replacement/spare part SKUs (valve cores, seals, o-rings, replacement kits). While valve insert types are mentioned, no comprehensive SKU count is provided.

45.evidenceText: DT Swiss uses their own proprietary "DT Swiss valve" for their tubeless wheelsets. The source makes no mention of Clik valve adoption. No evidence found of Clik valve adoption by any major wheelset brands (DT Swiss, Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval).
45.extractionRationale: The available evidence indicates DT Swiss uses their own "DT Swiss valve" design rather than Clik valve. With no evidence of Clik adoption by any of the 6 major brands mentioned, and given that only one brand was covered in the provided source, the percentage of major brands that have converted to Clik valve is 0%.

49.evidenceText: Three models explicitly list Clik valve: (1) 2025 Bergamont Grandurance LTD - "Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe G-One Bite Comp... Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve"; (2) 2025 Bergamont Grandurance 10 - "Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe G-One R... Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve"; (3) 2026 Bergamont Grandurance 10 - "Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe G-One R... Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve"
49.extractionRationale: Counted unique bicycle models that explicitly mention "Clik valve" in their tire/tube specifications across the five sources. Three distinct models were identified: Bergamont Grandurance 10 (2025), Bergamont Grandurance LTD (2025), and Bergamont Grandurance 10 (2026). Other models mentioned (Canyon, KTM, BULLS, Liv) did not show Clik valve specifications in the provided excerpts.

50.evidenceText: Evidence shows two distinct Clik Valve technical/information pages: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve - Valve FAQ page discussing Clik Valve features, and (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve - Dedicated Clik Valve product page with technical specifications and compatibility information.
50.extractionRationale: Counted distinct URLs specifically related to Clik valve technical documentation, guides, or FAQs. Excluded pages that mention Clik Valve only in passing (accessibility declaration, parts catalog, assembly videos for tires) and focused on pages dedicated to Clik Valve technology and instructions.
